items.title: How a RESONAL Song Gets Made — Running a Music Unit with Claude Code
items.summary: RESONAL is a music unit run by two of us: the AI vocalist 彩瀬?? and me (one human, one AI). I turned our production workflow into something anyone can use. This book shows how to make a song by talking with an AI — from planning, lyrics, composing and mastering to the music video and release prep. 日本語版：https://zenn.dev/apoto/books/resonal-pipeline
